data.headline: Can An Ex-Walmart Exec Help Rescue Kroger?
data.summary: On Monday, after a roughly year-long search, grocery giant Kroger announced its new top boss: veteran Walmart executive Greg Koran.  As an alumnus of the only grocer in America larger than Kroger by sales, Koran is stepping in at a critical time for the Ralph’s-Roundy’s-and-Dillon’s parent company as it navigates a cash-strapped consumer base in the wake of a failed 2024 merger with rival Albertson’s.  Downmarket, the company is facing heat from discount grocers such as Aldi.
